teaser.en: Its star-shaped fruits look handsome but hide itchy hairs, while its bark gives the rope that ties roofs together.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake yenye umbo la nyota yanapendeza kuyaona lakini yanaficha manyoya yanayowasha, na gome lake hutoa kamba inayofunga mapaa.
teaser.dg: Matundage ga umbo dza nyota ni manono kugalola, ela ganafwitsa nyere zinazoawisa; na gophare rinalavya kamba zinazofunga mapaa ga nyumba.

summary.en: *Mgoza*, the African star-chestnut, is a fat-trunked deciduous tree of hot, rocky hills with shiny peeling bark and woody star-shaped fruits. Its bark gives rope for tying thatch and house poles, and its light wood is used for simple furniture.
summary.sw: *Mgoza* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wenye shina nene, wa vilima vya joto vyenye miamba, wenye gome linalong'aa na kubambuka, na matunda magumu yenye umbo la nyota. Gome lake hutoa kamba ya kufungia makuti na nguzo za nyumba, na mti wake mwepesi hutumika kwa samani za kawaida.
summary.dg: *Mgoza* (kpwa Chingereza *African star-chestnut*) ni muhi wenye kolo rinaronona, ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wa myango ya mawe yenye dzoho, wenye gopha rinaroala na rinarogandulika, na matunda mafu dza muhi ga umbo dza nyota. Gophare rinalavya kamba za kufunga makuti na nguzo za nyumba, na nyama za muhi, zirizo phepheya, nkuhumirwa kuhenda fanicha za kawaida.

about.en:
*Mgoza* is easy to pick out on a dry hillside. The trunk is thick and fluted, and the bark is pale and shiny, flaking away to leave patches of purple and green. The leaves are broad with three to five lobes, a little like a hand, and the tree drops them in the dry season.

The fruit gives the tree its English name. Woody pods split open in a star of several segments, each holding seeds. Inside, the pods are lined with stiff hairs that irritate the skin, so they are best handled with care.
about.sw:
*Mgoza* ni rahisi kuutambua kwenye mteremko mkavu wa kilima. Shina lake ni nene na lenye mifereji, na gome lake ni jeupe-jeupe na linang'aa, likibambuka na kuacha mabaka ya zambarau na kijani. Majani yake ni mapana yenye mapindo matatu hadi matano, kidogo kama mkono, na mti huyapukutisha wakati wa kiangazi.

Tunda ndilo linalotoa jina la Kiingereza la mti huu. Maganda magumu kama mti hupasuka kwa umbo la nyota ya vipande kadhaa, kila kimoja kikiwa na mbegu. Ndani, maganda yamepangwa manyoya magumu yanayowasha ngozi, hivyo ni bora kuyashika kwa uangalifu.
about.dg:
*Mgoza* ni rahisi kuumanya dzulu ya mwango mkavu. Kolo ni rinono na rina mistari mire ya kuinama ndani, na gopha ni ra rangi ngushu-ngushu na rinaala; rinagandulika na kuricha mabara ga zambarau na ga chijani. Makodzage ni mapana, gana mala mahahu hadi matsano, chidide dza mkpwono, na nkugbwa wakati wa kazikazi.

Tunda ndiro rinaropha muhi uhu dzinare ra Chingereza. Makakaya mafu dza muhi ganaahuka na kukala dza nyota ya vipande kadhaa, na chila chipande china tembe. Ndani, makakaya ganakala na nyere ngumu zinazoawisa ngozi, kpwa hivyo ni lazima kugagbwira pore-pore.

where.en: *Mgoza* likes heat and rock. It grows on hot, dry, rocky hills and along the edges of woodland, often standing out from lower bush around it. In the dry season, bare and pale-barked, it is especially noticeable.
where.sw: *Mgoza* hupenda joto na miamba. Hukua kwenye vilima vya joto, vikavu vyenye miamba na kando ya misitu ya wazi, mara nyingi ukionekana wazi juu ya vichaka vifupi vinavyouzunguka. Wakati wa kiangazi, ukiwa hauna majani na gome lake jeupe-jeupe, huonekana zaidi.
where.dg: *Mgoza* unamendza dzoho na mawe. Unamera dzulu ya myango ya mawe yenye dzoho na mikavu, na kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga wazi, na mara nyinji unaonekana sana kahi ya vitsaka vifupi virivyouzunguluka. Wakati wa kazikazi, uchikala tauna makodza na gophare ni ngushu-ngushu, unaonekana zaidi.

uses.en:
The bark is stripped for rope, which is used to tie thatch and house poles together, an important job in traditional house building. The bark is also used for mats.

The wood is light and is used for local furniture. The tree also yields a gum.
uses.sw:
Gome hubambuliwa kutengeneza kamba, inayotumika kufunga makuti na nguzo za nyumba pamoja, kazi muhimu katika ujenzi wa nyumba za jadi. Gome pia hutumika kwa mikeka.

Mti wake ni mwepesi na hutumika kwa samani za kienyeji. Mti huu pia hutoa ulimbo.
uses.dg:
Gopha nkugandulwa kpwa kuhenda kamba, zinazohumirwa kufunga makuti na nguzo za nyumba phamwenga, kazi muhimu kpwa kudzenga nyumba za chienyeji. Gopha piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda micheka.

Nyama za muhi ni phepheya na nkuhumirwa kuhenda fanicha za chienyeji. Muhi piya unalavya gamu.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name *mgoza*. Pakia uses *mgoza* for a related star-chestnut, *Sterculia rhynchocarpa*, so the name may cover more than one species. In Swahili it is *mgoza* or *ngozo*, and in Giriama *muoria*. In English it is the African star-chestnut.
names.sw: Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo *mgoza*. Pakia anatumia *mgoza* kwa mti mwingine wa jamii yake, *Sterculia rhynchocarpa*, hivyo huenda jina hili linajumuisha spishi zaidi ya moja. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mgoza* au *ngozo*, na kwa Kigiriama *muoria*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *African star-chestnut*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha dzina ra Chidigo *mgoza*. Pakia anahumira *mgoza* kpwa muhi wanjina wa jenasi mwenga, *Sterculia rhynchocarpa*, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rinaweza kukala ni ra aina zaidi ya mwenga. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mgoza* au *ngozo*, na kpwa Chigiryama ni *muoria*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *African star-chestnut*.
